description: This file contains a Jetpack Compose UI component for rendering Markdown-formatted chat messages, including parsing Markdown syntax, rendering various block elements (headings, paragraphs, code blocks, lists, tables, etc.), and handling inline styles and images within the Markdown content.

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class holding style configuration for inline Markdown elements like code snippets and links.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row in a rendered Markdown table, including whether it is a header and the cell contents.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Data class for storing parsed image data from a Markdown image node, including MIME type and base64 data.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main composable function that takes Markdown text and renders it as styled chat content.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Recursively renders different Markdown block elements into Composables.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders a paragraph or inline content, handles images embedded as base64 data URLs.

methods.name: RenderBulletList
methods.description: Renders a bulleted list of items.

methods.name: RenderOrderedList
methods.description: Renders an ordered list of items.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders a single list item, supporting task list markers and nested content.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Renders a Markdown table with support for headers and scrolling.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Constructs a list of table rows from a TableBlock node.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads header or body section of a table to extract rows.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Reads a single table row to extract cell content.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Builds an AnnotatedString with inline Markdown styles from a node.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Processes inline Markdown nodes, applying styles and appending text.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from a node and its children.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Checks if a paragraph contains a single inline image with data URL scheme.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses a data URL to extract MIME type and base64-encoded image data.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Returns a TextStyle for a heading of a given level.
